question: Indulgeo Essentials avocado oil company parent owner
markdown:
Indulgeo Essentials is an independent Indian natural skincare brand founded in 2016 by
Supriya Malik
, who serves as the founder and CEO. The company operates independently without a larger corporate parent conglomerate and was established under the guidance of her mother, Seema Arora.
